description:
Calculates similarity metrics for gene neighborhoods

Takes a genbank file annotated with domainator and calculates similarities between contigs and writes reports.

ji, ai, and dss metrics are similar to and inspired by the metrics used in the BigScape method:
Navarro-Muñoz, Jorge C., Nelly Selem-Mojica, Michael W. Mullowney, Satria A. Kautsar, James H. Tryon, Elizabeth I. Parkinson, Emmanuel L. C. De Los Santos, et al. "A Computational Framework to Explore Large-Scale Biosynthetic Diversity from Large-Scale Genomic Data." Nature Chemical Biology 16, no. 1 (January 2020): 60–68. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41589-019-0400-9.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.help: Name of genbank output, contigs will be sorted hierarchically within the output genbank. If not supplied then no genbank output will be generated. To write to stdout, use '-'. default: None

parameters.name: Ji
parameters.help: weighting for jaccard index metric, a comparison of all distinct types of domains in the contigs. When two contigs have no domains, their ji is 1.0.

parameters.name: Ai
parameters.help: weighting for adjacency index metric, a comparison of shared domain pairs in the contigs. When two contigs have 0 or 1 domains, their ai is 1.0.

parameters.name: Databases
parameters.help: Domain databases to use for domain content comparison. default: all databases.

parameters.name: HDF5 matrix
parameters.help: Write the matrix to this Domainator hdf5 file. Values are stored sparse; a matrix with exactly symmetric values is stored as its upper triangle.

parameters.name: Dense Text
parameters.help: Write the matrix to this tab-separated text file, every cell included.

advanced_parameters.name: Contigs
advanced_parameters.help: only annotate contigs with ids in this list. Additive with --contigs_file. default: all contigs.

advanced_parameters.name: Contigs File
advanced_parameters.help: only annotate contigs with ids listed in this file (one per line). Additive with --contigs. default: all contigs.

advanced_parameters.name: Name By Order
advanced_parameters.help: Will rename contigs in the genbank file such that they have a prefix that can be sorted to restore the sorted order.

advanced_parameters.name: Linkage
advanced_parameters.help: Hierarchical clustering linkage method used to sort contigs for the genbank output. Distances are 1 - score/max(score); pairs with no score have distance 1.

advanced_parameters.name: Leaf Ordering
advanced_parameters.help: How to order the leaves of the clustering tree for the genbank output. greedy: fast and usually about as good as optimal. optimal: very slow (minutes to hours) beyond a few thousand contigs. none: plain dendrogram order.

advanced_parameters.name: Skip Sort Memory Check
advanced_parameters.help: Don't fail early when sorting the contigs for the genbank output is estimated to need more memory than is available.

advanced_parameters.name: Max hits per query
advanced_parameters.help: After combining all metric scores, keep this many of the top hits for each query. Applied before MST and kNN pruning.

advanced_parameters.name: Max Output Gb
advanced_parameters.help: Fail if a projected output file would exceed this many GB. Set to 0 to disable the guardrail.

advanced_parameters.name: MST
advanced_parameters.help: Keep only the edges of the maximum spanning tree (forest). The clusters are the same as the full graph's, with the connections inside each cluster pruned to the minimum needed to keep it connected. Combine with kNN to also keep each node's nearest neighbors. Computed while streaming.

advanced_parameters.name: kNN
advanced_parameters.help: Keep only OR-symmetric K-nearest-neighbor edges (K at least 1): an edge is kept if it is among the K best for either of its nodes. On its own this can split a cluster of the full graph into several; combine with MST to keep the clusters connected. Computed while streaming.
